notes: In the Photo Lab, picking a character is picking her LoRAs. Her card's LoRAs no longer sit in the checklist waiting to be ticked; they appear under the dropdown the moment she is chosen, each with its strength ready to edit, and they ride because she was picked: identity LoRAs on the main paint and the face pass, any detail-pass LoRA on her card on its part, and her trigger words in the prompt, exactly as a chat would do it. The checklist below now holds only the shared LoRAs from Settings, which is what it is for. Leaving the character at None paints without an identity, and the Lab says so.
